correction: The earlier demand that cold completion reject arbitrary substituted NI data after a local owner consistently rewrites all local hashes is overstrong under the accepted trusted-local-player model. It is withdrawn as a required anti-owner authentication property. The line-222 syntax versus live-lines-312/313 source observation remains true; it does not by itself prove that a separate cold trust anchor is needed.
retainedRequirements: Strict supported child schema and exact ordered returned-I value; no absent/invalid child promoted to a live pass.
Actual genuine NI/common/take producer coupling before publication, and stable same-operation generation/original/current-image/history/receipt crosslinks on cold read.
Reject accidental corruption, malformed/unsupported values, mixed-operation or stale substituted data that violates those independent context bindings; no secret or owner-proof signature requirement.

Resolve existing journal/recovery before acceptance; preserve unknown-state evidence and once-only effects. Repeated cold consumption may repeat read-only diagnostics, never projector/clock/write/materialization.
WRITE/READY observation contracts concern real application ordering and complete consumption; do not convert them into immunity against intentional external owner races.
evidenceBoundary: Source/model assessment only. No test execution, baseline outcome, full design acceptance or tests/runtime release. Await the one saved concrete cold candidate and independently specified live-only fixture.
